style: Candid home-cooked food, soft window daylight, restrained colors, imperfect plating, realistic textures; landscape 1536x1024; no text or glossy studio finish.

subjects.name: GreenMoleTacos
subjects.subject: Three soft corn tortillas with roasted zucchini and vegetables, generous earthy green tomatillo poblano pumpkin-seed mole, sparse cilantro, no meat or cheese, casually overlapping on a simple ceramic plate.

subjects.name: LemonHerbOrzo
subjects.subject: Cooked rice-shaped orzo pasta with wilted spinach, irregular crumbled feta, fresh dill and a lemon wedge, in an everyday shallow ceramic bowl.

subjects.name: Shakshuka
subjects.subject: Five eggs gently poached in chunky red tomato and pepper sauce with smoked paprika and sparse parsley, in a well-used dark skillet.

subjects.name: TuscanStew
subjects.subject: Tuscan cannellini white bean stew with wilted dark kale and rosemary in a modest ceramic soup bowl, thick brothy consistency.

subjects.name: MisoUdon
subjects.subject: Thick Japanese udon noodles coated lightly in miso butter with chopped scallions and a lime wedge, in a simple everyday Japanese ceramic bowl. No egg or meat.

subjects.name: ChanaMasala
subjects.subject: Indian chana masala, chickpeas in a thick tomato onion spice gravy, a few coriander leaves, in a modest steel serving bowl.

subjects.name: Bibimbap
subjects.subject: Korean vegetable bibimbap in a ceramic bowl, rice with cooked carrot, zucchini, spinach, shiitake mushrooms, bean sprouts, kimchi and a single fried egg with gochujang. No meat.
